subject.title: [Feature]: REST endpoint for session management in HTTP API integrations

question: Should OpenClaw expose mutating `/v1/sessions/*` HTTP session controls for trusted HTTP integrations, and which operations and operator scopes should be allowed?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but automation cannot safely decide the permanent HTTP control-plane security boundary for reset, compaction, model, and reasoning mutations.

options.title: Approve narrow admin-scoped REST controls
options.body: Add focused authenticated endpoints that reuse existing session handlers, require appropriate operator scopes, and include route/auth/docs coverage.

options.title: Ship reset/status first
options.body: Limit the first HTTP surface to the common reset and read-only status needs while deferring model, reasoning, and compaction until the security model is clearer.

options.title: Decline mutating REST controls
options.body: Keep WebSocket/RPC and plugin APIs as the supported control planes and document that HTTP Chat Completions remains chat-only.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow admin-scoped REST controls
recommendation.body: Add focused authenticated endpoints that reuse existing session handlers, require appropriate operator scopes, and include route/auth/docs coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns recent privileged HTTP RPC/security-boundary work and already appears in the discussion as the reviewer framing the needed product/security decision.
